name: usql
description: Universal command-line interface for SQL databases supporting 30+ database types

tools.description: Universal SQL client supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Oracle, SQL Server and many others
tools.usage:
usql postgres://user:pass@host/db # Connect to PostgreSQL
usql mysql://user:pass@host/db # Connect to MySQL
usql sqlite:database.db # Connect to SQLite
usql 'SELECT * FROM users;' # Execute query directly
usql --drivers # List supported database drivers
